title: Turkish-Style Kofte with Savory Sauce
description: A twist on traditional Chinese cuisine, this dish combines the flavors of Turkey with the savory sauce of China. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: Savory sauce (hoisin and soy sauce mixture)

instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add sliced potatoes and cook until golden brown.
Add kofte and cook until browned on all sides.
In a separate bowl, mix hoisin and soy sauce.
Add the savory sauce to the pan with the kofte and potatoes.
Stir to combine and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Season with Turkish seasoning to taste.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
